Found this by chance and we were very happy to do so.
It's a small venue on a corner near a busy junction and we sat in the window watching the amazing spectacle of mopeds weaving in and out of traffic and pedestrians trying to cross the road.
As for the bar, all 4 of us had Itty Bitty chicken Titties, which were chicken breast balls in breadcrumbs with a dip. And cheap at that.
Theres a lot of ales to choose from and they were all very good quality, the bar mad was knowledgeable about the ale on sale as well.

Great bar even though a bit small, if you see it definitely go in to sample the beer and food

Awesome beers highly recommended
Feb 2020 • Couples
I stumbled across here after visiting the near bye Ban Thia Market, this place is a must for anyone who likes beer. It's spread across 3 floors with nice air conditioning free WiFi offered. It's reasonably priced and has a good food menu. The beers they have loads for you to try both on tap/draught and bottles and cans. The beers are mostly local beers from ho chi minh breweries and other Vietnamese brewerys. This venue is truly embracing the current craft beer explosion in Vietnam. I highly recommend it as a relaxed bar with friendly staff, its a must for any beer fan to try out whilst in ho chi minh City. I would recommend this venue to friends and family and will visit here again

Beyond Impossible...the Phenomenal Burger
Nov 2019 • Solo
Sorry Vegans* but living in SE Asia for several years can really leave you craving a real beef burger. Biacraft scores high in my book with their new Smash Burger; I ordered the double (VND 220) and it was phenomenal.

They've perfectly balanced a blend of various cuts of beef that come together to form a single harmonious patty. It was obvious that it was simply prepared and not overworked

The burger was presented in a fresh light brioche roll layered with melted American cheese, a piece of bib lettuce, a single slice of ripe beefsteak tomato, thinly sliced onion, and refreshing dill pickle rounds. The sauce seems likely a blend of kewpie mayo and catsup which I can't fault at all. It was enough to enhance the flavor of the burger without detracting from the natural flavor of the burger itself.

And if that wasn't enough, the new location is very comfortable with great seating, airflow/cooling, and the same pleasant staff.

I paired mine with a pint of Loose Rivet IPA (VND 160) from Heart of Darkness, my personal favorite beer in Vietnam.

* Biacraft does offer a Beyond Burger which I have not yet tried.

The Intrepid Beard
Bangkok, Thailand17 contributions

Revamped venue.
Nov 2019 • Solo
Went to the reopening of the Baicraft in Thao Dien on a Monday night, a good crowd of expats and locals. With 30 taps of mostly local craft beer varying in price and also have a nice selection of cans. There is an outside area and a covered section. It's no thrills but still a cool space, with graffiti walls, wood and metal pipe tables and metal stools. 

This visit I had the Mekong Brewing Co Blue Elephant IPA which was OK but not great from the med price range. Then I found the Heart of Darkness Dream Alone pale ale a fantastic fruity American Pale. I also had the BiaCraft own oreo stout, creamy, smooth and delicious.

In the way of food they have a great pub grub available from wings, sandwiches to steak, sausages and the smashed burger! I had the latter 2 patties cheese, salad and onions. They also have the beyond meat burger that I must say did look temping. I'll be back for sure
